section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) investigating a model of positive body image with 249 college women. The study used path analysis to examine body appreciation as a mediator linking interpersonal variables (caregiver eating messages, adult attachment) and intrapersonal variables (perfectionism) to intuitive eating and depressive symptoms. The findings support body appreciation's mediating role in the relationship between these variables and eating behaviors.
